title: PufferfishGaming's craft tweaks
description: It is a crafting related datapack, but I also included a version for modloaders.
body:
This datapack just rebalances vanilla crafting, like being able to craft notch apples or a trident.

-Craftable enchanted golden apples

-Smeltable raw ore blocks

-Cookable rotten flash

-Grind down armor or tools to the material it is made of

-Much, much more things to explore and try!

# FAQ: 

Can I include this mod in a modpack?
Yes, you can, just don't forget to give credit to me.

Will you update/downgrade the mod/datapack for 1.##.#?     
Yes, I will, just DM me and I will release the version asap.

Will you add (something) to the mod? 
Yes, just DM me the idea, and if I like it, I will release a new version of the datapack.

Discord: thepufferfishgaming
